blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for product counsel work — launch review, marketing claims, feature risk assessment, and fast triage. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Product Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable Product Practice Profile — what blocks at your company, escalation paths, and house formats. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Is This a Problem? — Quick Triage
prompts.description: Fast triage of a quick product-counsel question — fine / needs a look / hold — pattern-matched against your calibration.

prompts.title: Feature Risk Assessment
prompts.description: Assess one feature against your risk calibration and surface the legal domains that need deeper review.

prompts.title: Marketing Claims Review
prompts.description: Review marketing copy before ship — extract claims, classify them, and flag what needs substantiation or a disclosure.

prompts.title: Launch Review
prompts.description: Coordinated legal review of a product launch from the uploaded PRD, mocks, and marketing materials, with a launch-gate recommendation.
